body:
✈️ Age of Aviation (NeoForge 1.21.1)

Age of Aviation is a next-generation tech-focused Vanilla+ modpack that completely redefines logistics, automation, and world exploration in Minecraft. Forget the old limits—the entire world is now your canvas and your flight deck!  
✨ Key Features

    🛠️ The Era of Flight: The absolute core of this modpack is the Create ecosystem paired with the revolutionary Create Aeronautics addon. Build fully functional airships, custom zeppelins, and floating factories that physically move through the sky!  

    🌍 Infinite Horizons (LODs): Thanks to the integration of Distant Horizons, your render distance goes far beyond standard limits. Marvel at breathtaking landscapes hundreds of chunks away and map out your long-distance flights with zero FPS drops.  

    🍂 Dynamic Seasons & Elements: Explore the stunning biomes of Biomes O' Plenty, which adapt to the laws of nature. Serene Seasons and WinterOverhaul introduce realistic seasonal cycles and harsh winter mechanics, throwing a serious challenge at your factory heating systems.  

    🍳 Automated Cooking & Comfort: Expand your bases and automate high-tier kitchens using Farmers Delight and its dedicated Create integration (Create-Central-Kitchen).  

    ⚡ Flawless Optimization: Built on top-tier performance engines like Sodium/Embeddium and Iris, and backed by essential utilities such as Entity Culling and FerriteCore. Enjoy buttery-smooth gameplay and high framerates, even when your massive factory lines are running at full steam.  

📦 Core Mod Categories

    Engineering & Automation: Create, Create Aeronautics, Create-Enchantment-Industry, Create-Central-Kitchen, Copycats.  

    Exploration & Environment: Biomes O' Plenty, Serene Seasons, WinterOverhaul, Farmers Delight.  

    Graphics, Optimization & UI: Distant Horizons, Sodium, Iris, Jade, Mod Menu, Simple Voice Chat.  

🚀 Installation Guide

    Download a modern Minecraft launcher with built-in Modrinth support (e.g., Prism Launcher or the Modrinth App).  

    Create a new instance set to Minecraft 1.21.1 running the NeoForge mod loader.  

    Drop all the .jar mod files directly into the instance's mods folder.  

    Allocate at least 6 GB of RAM in your launcher settings for smooth Distant Horizons rendering.
